paragraphs: CSiT provides integrated solutions for transit systems, connecting how service is operated with how passengers move, and turning transit data into information staff can act on. The work covers operations and mobility management along with system integration for bus, tramway, and train networks.

The stated method is to standardize, integrate, and automate every component that makes a city move. Those parts sit on a shared data fabric rather than as separate systems. Coverage reaches trains, tramways, buses, stations, bus stops, and control centres, which are meant to adapt as operational needs change. The two areas the company names as its expertise are operations management and passenger communications.

CSiT and TRANSIS are registered trademarks of CSINTRANS Inc. The company points to its adherence to international standards as part of what shapes its technology. It says its approach supports customers before, during, and after every stage of a project.
